race.comment: It is nearly a year since VITTOZZI (11) won her only race but she put the writing on the wall last start, leading for the judge only to be reeled in late to finish third over 1000m at Scone. Drops back from a Class 2 to a Class 1. May take a sit today from the middle gate and will be tough to hold out. ROCKBARTON SPEAR (7) is a lightly raced four-year-old back after a 31-week spell. Raced just three times in the maiden campaign with a barnstorming win over 1206m at this track the high point. Will get back in the run but has the ability to finish over the top of them. POSHY'S GIRL (4) returns from a four-month break for a second campaign. Competitive right through the first prep with every run on a wet track. Gets the right conditions to put her best foot forward. REAL MCCOY (6) has been freshened up since closing late to get up for second over 1000m at Muswellbrook on 5 October. Should give a good account. THE WARRIOR (5) is better than recent form suggests and can improve.
